evidence.ref: prediction_api.legal_context_access permits DV.load(split) for inference-time tab

expected_observation: If tab miscalibration is real, validation primary improves mainly through tabs 0/2/6 or through improved marginal portfolio contribution despite limited standalone movement.

experiment_contract.claim: A fixed inference-time tab-conditioned monotone transform of LambdaRank scores can improve ranking by correcting context-specific miscalibration.
experiment_contract.expected_observable: Predictions for identical raw scores but different tabs separate systematically; tabs listed in diagnostics show changed score distributions
experiment_contract.falsification_condition: Primary does not improve or diagnostics show no tab-specific benefit, refuting the miscalibration hypothesis.
forbidden_shortcuts: changing train-time labels/features while claiming pure calibration
using any exposure-after-feedback signal at inference
required_components: predict block must apply different monotone transforms for at least two tab groups
base scores must originate from unmodified SO.predict

fallback: If this fails, escalate to train-time tab interaction features instead of postscore calibration.
hypothesis: The parent LambdaRank branch has tab-structured score miscalibration; a fixed tab-conditional monotone transform can improve top-5 ordering and diversify against the other members without retraining.
implementation_plan: Patch predict only. After SO.predict, load split rows via DV.load(split), and apply a fixed monotone piecewise-linear transform per coarse tab bucket {0,1,2,4,6,other}. Use predeclared slopes/intercepts centered near identity, with stronger expansion/compression only for tabs where the LambdaRank branch is diagnostically weak in the portfolio. The transform must be monotone within each tab so it changes cross-tab score comparability but preserves within-tab local ordering except for scale shifts; because users can see mixed tabs, this can alter within-user ranking legally using inference-time tab.
justification: Because both official metrics rank within user, any lawful context that varies by candidate can be used at prediction time. Tab is an exposed candidate/context field and diagnostics indicate systematic tab-specific weakness, making post-score calibration a targeted structural diversification hypothesis rather than scalar retuning.
mechanism: tab-specific monotone score calibration on LambdaRank outputs
observation: Portfolio diagnostics for w003 show strong tab disadvantages: delta_primary -0.01749022029153391 on tab=0 and -0.009346696620826433 on tab=2; the latest candidate also degraded tabs 0/1/2/6. The predict API explicitly allows calling DV.load(split) to read inference-time tab.
research_nonuse_reason: No supplied E### directly studies a fixed tab-specific monotone postscore transform for this single LambdaRank branch. The more direct basis is the exact tab-slice diagnostics plus the legal prediction-time access to tab in the runtime contract.
risk: monotone transforms may not affect enough mixed-tab users
poorly chosen fixed slopes can hurt already-strong tab 4
